desc:
🔥 Welcome to +1 Skill Point Legends! 🔥
Earn +1 Skill Point every second just by playing — and get even more by defeating monsters and epic bosses! 💥

Use your skill points to upgrade your:
⚔️ Damage
✨ Magic Power
❤️ Health
⚡ Speed
🦘 Jump Power

🎁 LOOT & GEAR 
• 🗡️ Collect weapons, staffs, and armors
• 🎒 Open Chests to find rare loot
• 👹 Chests can drop from monsters you defeat
• ⭐ Become stronger with every new item you equip

🎮 FEATURES
• 📈 Gain skill points every second
• 👹 Fight monsters & bosses for bonus points
• 🚀 Upgrade your stats to become unstoppable
• 🌎 Explore, battle, and grow infinitely
• 🛠️ Constant updates — game is in BETA!

⚠️ All bans related to exploiting are permanent. There will be no appeals.

Boss Spawns in Private Servers: To prevent abuse, bosses in private servers are set to "dead" when the server starts.

⭐ Support us by Liking & Favoriting the game!
Thanks for playing! ❤️
